dependencies.name: libvips
dependencies.install_hint: brew install vips (macOS) or apt install libvips-dev (Linux)

dependencies.name: imagemagick
dependencies.install_hint: brew install imagemagick (macOS) or apt install imagemagick (Linux)
dependencies.description: Required for PDF and additional format support via libvips

dependencies.name: ghostscript
dependencies.install_hint: brew install ghostscript (macOS) or apt install ghostscript (Linux)

dependencies.name: imagemagick-pdf-delegate
dependencies.install_hint: Install ghostscript then reinstall imagemagick: brew reinstall imagemagick
dependencies.description: ImageMagick must be built with PDF delegate support. If missing, reinstall imagemagick after installing ghostscript.
